svg.title: The laminated card in every van
svg.text: 09 · THE CARD IN EVERY VAN (BOTH SIDES)
Type it or say it. Photos too.
Stuck? Ring Lisa. Something broken? Halyard’s on the WhatsApp group.
Check the draft on your phone
It copies your codes. Fix, then approve.
C1? Make it safe, ring Craig
“Our office assistant. A person checks it all.”
Nothing here needs a new app. ServiceM8 and iCertifi, as now.
